name: Ashiya Miwa
source:
[b]Workplace:[/b] Minatoya Restaurant
[b]Favorite ice cream:[/b] Chocomint
[b]Hobby:[/b] Cooking

Kazumi, Sarah, and Suzune’s childhood friend.
She likes Kazumi but can’t be honest about her feelings. She believes she already had her “first experience” with him, but since he only “went halfway,” she still considers herself a virgin.
She plays basketball at university.
